representation_gap_rule: v0 search arms cover only the monomial family; the generator also draws exponential, two-term and regime laws. For law-recovery cells (discoverable, spurious_correlate, confounded) there is NO STRONG APPLICABLE BASELINE for worlds whose truth is outside the family (Genesis §10.5 rule 4). The rule is PER WORLD: out-of-family worlds are reported as NO_STRONG_BASELINE and excluded from every lift computation; a law-recovery cell enters the lift family only with >= 10 in-family worlds.
representation_limited_rule: a (kind, presentation) cell is REPRESENTATION_LIMITED when monomial_enumeration's full-credit rate has a cluster-bootstrap 95% lower bound >= 0.5 at the formal tier: that cell measures the representation, and no lift there is credited as reasoning. Pilot values are indicative only.
reveal_protocol: master seed derived from a pilot root committed here by sha256 before any run
proposals stored content-addressed and sealed by one escrow score each
answer key exported by the operator only after every universe is sealed
independent evaluator re-scores every sealed proposal; any disagreement invalidates the run
presented cards audited against the key; trap instances verified (textbook law must fail)
the pilot root is revealed with the pilot results (the pilot is not held out)
security_boundary: SECURITY_BOUNDARY_NOT_PROVEN: the proposer runs in a separate process under the SAME OS account (heap scan, stack walk and environment attacks refused, tested; on Linux YAMA ptrace scope >= 1 refuses parent-memory reads); file reads by the same account are NOT prevented. No result counts as novel discovery.

tier1_pilot.purpose: cost and variance measurement ONLY; never a rate or lift claim

tier2_formal.isolation: proposer_process required: every arm, the Mind included, runs each campaign in a fresh interpreter that never holds the escrow, the master seed or a hidden world; an in_process run is INVALID for the formal tier
tier2_formal.lift_decision_rule: analysis.lift_decision: the paired per-campaign difference to the strongest baseline has a cluster-bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0 for the pooled primary endpoint after Holm correction (alpha 0.05) over the FIXED family pooled, anonymous, renamed, paraphrased, trap; AND every control kind's paired mean difference has a lower bound > -0.1 (no trading control failures for discovery credit)
rules: every arm reported for every cell
a defective task is INVALID_BENCHMARK with a new identity and a rerun from preregistration
invalid runs are reported and never aggregated
arms may be ADDED by a new identity, never removed or weakened
tier2_formal.start_condition: G0 exit (OD-3), owner-approved compute budget (OD-18), evaluator decision (OD-8), escrow deployment decision (OD-20), this identity approved (OD-19)
tier2_formal.strongest_baseline_rule: the non-adversarial arm (competence, floor or sanity role) with the highest formal-tier PRIMARY score; frozen in a baseline-freeze addendum (digest) BEFORE any Mind run
tier2_formal.world_reuse: one master root per (campaign, presentation), committed by sha256 before the campaign and revealed after, SHARED by every arm and every seed (paired lift); never reused across campaigns or presentations; ids and names pseudonymised per run

statistics.unit_of_analysis: the CAMPAIGN (one hidden world of every kind) for the primary endpoint; per world for descriptive cells. Seeds are averaged per world and never pooled as instances. Intervals: percentile bootstrap over campaigns (2000 resamples, Random(0)).
